rules.rationale: Multiple N/O sites both donate and accept water hydrogen bonds, the dominant favorable hydration term.
Moderate heteroatom content still supplies hydrogen-bonding functionality without excessive nonpolar bulk.
Pure hydrocarbons hydrate poorly; cavity formation in water's network dominates with no compensating hydrogen bonds.
Heavily halogenated surfaces are polarizable but weak hydrogen bonders, raising net desolvation cost.

skills.hypothesis: Hydration affinity tracks hydrogen-bonding capacity minus hydrophobic cavity cost, so heteroatom-rich, weakly halogenated solutes rank highest. Fails if the score rewards halogen bonding or nonpolar burial.

rules.rationale: Acyclic solutes expose less rigid nonpolar surface; source ring role carried the highest transfer weight, 0.758.
Flat aromatic faces are hydrophobic; their absence reduces cavity work in aqueous solvation.
Counter-hypothesis: reverses the low-confidence 0.22 ESOL size prior, since longer chains can add hydrating groups.
Heavy branching builds compact nonpolar cores that shield polar sites from water contact.

skills.hypothesis: Scaffold topology, not size, drives hydration: acyclic non-aromatic low-branch solutes gain while the weak ESOL size penalty is reversed. Fails if polar functionality dominates topology.

lesson: Across two development generations the polarity/hydrogen-bonding skill led on mean rank AUC (72.9 then 67.9) while size-transfer and scaffold-shape variants stayed near 54-56; sparse bins like aromatic_high and ring_token_high (2-3 candidates) contributed almost no usable signal. Evidence is directional from few seeds, not causal.
revision_summary: Kept the winning polar mechanism but replaced the sparse two-condition interaction with a broader hetero_mid main effect, so rules cover well-populated bins (28/91/207/43 candidates) instead of rare ones. The second skill drops the near-empty aromatic_high and ring_token_high penalties that underperformed and instead rewards the large acyclic and non-aromatic populations while explicitly reversing the low-confidence 0.22 ESOL size prior. Both keep decaying semantic mass; the polar skill is frozen for deployment.
